User.title: User Profile
User.description: User account registration details and security access roles.

uid.description: The unique system-assigned Firebase Authentication UID.

email.description: The registered corporate email address of the user.

role.description: The systemic authorization role assigned to this user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the account profile was created.

Version.title: Dataset Version
Version.description: A saved workbook or report version uploaded and managed by a user.

name.description: The user-assigned label or name of the dataset version.

date.description: ISO timestamp indicating when the version was saved.

rows.description: The count of rows stored in the dataset version.

data.description: Static table rows associated with this saved version.

filters.description: Active filter configurations applied when saving.

ownerUid.description: The owner UID who saved this dataset.

ownerEmail.description: The owner email who saved this dataset.

users/{userId}.description: The core repository of user access profiles.

versions/{versionId}.description: Collection of workbook and data slice versions.
